svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Housing: 4 mm plate box 228 x 190 x 200 mm tall, open at the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the hopper outlet; 100 mm round outlet in the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rotor: 40 mm hub on a 20 mm shaft, two 8 mm plates welded across

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it to make four vanes, 160 mm diameter, 194 mm long, 6 mm end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: discs; 3 mm clear of the housing all round. About 0.77 L a pocket.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shaft: in two flange bearings on the housing ends; it runs inward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to a 15-tooth sprocket beside the carriage post.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain up to a matching sprocket on the 20 mm crank shaft, which

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: passes over the top rail to a 140 mm crank and handle on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: deck side, 1,260 mm above the floor. Sheet guard round the chain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: rotor turns by hand with no rub; one turn, four pockets.
